definitions.explanation: Capable of being changed or adjusted. Used primarily as a modifier in technical and product description contexts to indicate that something can be varied.

examples.japanese: {可変|かへん}⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦モーター→モーター：23127_mootaa⟧。
⟦{角度|かくど}→角度：00156_kakudo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{可変|かへん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スタンド→スタンド：00394_sutando⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I'm using a stand with an adjustable angle.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{椅子|いす}→椅子：00706_isu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{可変|かへん}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: This chair has adjustable height, so it can be used by both children and adults.

notes:
A technical modifier meaning "variable" or "adjustable." Most commonly appears before another noun to describe something that can be changed or modified. Contrasts with ⟦{固定|こてい}→固定：10996_kotei⟧ (fixed).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {可変|かへん}⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧: variable speed
- {可変|かへん}⟦{抵抗|ていこう}→抵抗：03540_teikou⟧: variable resistor
- {可変|かへん}⟦{長|ちょう}→〜長：04665_chou⟧: variable length
- {可変|かへん}⟦{翼|つばさ}→翼：03528_tsubasa⟧: variable-geometry wing (swing wing)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{固定|こてい}→固定：10996_kotei⟧: fixed, stationary — the direct opposite; something that cannot be changed
- ⟦{調節|ちょうせつ}→調節：17947_chousetsu⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧: adjustable — a more explanatory way to say the same thing; more common in everyday speech
- ⟦{変動|へんどう}→変動：09936_hendou⟧: fluctuation, variation — describes natural or market-driven changes rather than user-adjustable settings

ETYMOLOGY:
{可|か} (possible) + ⟦{変|へん}→変：01124_hen⟧ (change) — "able to be changed."
